title: Limited glTF 2.0 mesh, hierarchy and animation interchange

supportedProfile: Triangle mesh accessors, hierarchy, shared primitives and reflected nonuniform transforms
Opaque KHR_materials_unlit base colors and explicit limited material fallback
Selected STEP or LINEAR translation/scale and shortest-path quaternion SLERP
External-buffer glTF and equivalent binary GLB; optional finite static camera with a proper rigid global basis
excluded: Full AuthorScene, math relations or lecture-cue round trips
Skinning, morph targets, compressed geometry, textures and general shaders
Cubic spline animation, dynamic topology and implicit remote asset loading

upstream.role: Primary format and unlit-material contracts for an independently written bounded importer, exporter and numeric oracle. No upstream implementation or fixture is copied.

license.note: The pinned specification source declares CC-BY-4.0. This work links and attributes the primary sources and implements the format independently; it does not redistribute specification text or upstream code/assets.

inputs: An explicit glTF JSON document and resolved binary buffers, or native .gltf/.glb capture
A selected supported animation, optional camera and explicit material policy
Self-authored faceted shared-mesh fixture with external and embedded equivalent containers
outputs: Validated shared mesh resources, scoped hierarchy and numeric animation tracks
A preserved/converted/unsupported report and explicit sidecar boundary for native math metadata
Bounded glTF delivery export for the declared supported subset
coordinates: Right-handed Y-up metres become right-handed Z-up metres using (x,y,z) -> (x,-z,y)
Local geometry and node bases are converted consistently; camera optical axes require separate basis accounting
Normals use inverse transpose; negative determinant affects winding independently
STEP is right-continuous; quaternion LINEAR channels use shortest-path SLERP
errorPolicy: Reject malformed accessor bounds/alignment and missing or mismatched buffer payloads
Reject unsupported required extensions, unsupported animation channels and hierarchy cycles
Reject unsupported materials unless fallback is explicit and recorded
Reject non-rigid or animated global camera transforms whose native affine view would change under glTF camera rules
Record float32 accessor rounding; reject distinct animation knots that collapse after conversion
Do not run external assets as code or claim full Texloom semantic round-trip preservation

claims: Actual .gltf and .glb fixture payloads are equivalent and independently reproducible
Both containers pass pinned official Khronos gltf-validator2.0.0-dev.3.10 with zero errors and warnings
Independent Python reference computes source hierarchy, normals, reflections, SLERP and STEP boundaries from float32 bytes
Actual shared-runtime world coordinates and normals match the independent oracle at knots and intermediate times
Reverse sampling preserves the source and shared mesh identity; selected camera optical axes are checked
notEstablished: Full glTF extension coverage or general rendering conformance
Skinned/morphed/textured or physically based asset interchange
Recovery of mathematical relations, anonymous field graphs or lecture cues from glTF
Identical GPU pixels across browsers or graphics drivers
